sourceReview.reason: TokenPost and Crypto Briefing repeat the $2.7 billion seven-day DEX-volume figure and Aero's 28.3% share, but they do not establish independent provenance and Token Terminal's public explorer still does not expose the dated tokenized-stock snapshot in reproducible full text. The primary measurement remains unverifiable.
